intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.6.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 19.05 MB RSS -83.5%, 113.7ms cold boot, Unified Pre-Publish Revenue & Playtest Gate + Auto-Fix cards, +Δ pts Autopilot score deltas, 17 pre-gzipped UI chunks, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 5,610 req/s), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.1.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with 340–380px zero-clipping tabs, Worker Activity Peek, 1-click Copy Swarm Digest, 128 KB incremental byte-offset JSONL tailing giving 129.0 MB RSS & 72.3ms boot, Needs-You Triage & plan.json gates, @mention Graph replay, cached git worktree probes, and 22/22 cold fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.15.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 15 pre-gzipped .rodata /chunks/* giving 33.3 KB initial shell -97.2% wire, 6.17ms cold boot, 33.98 MB RSS -27.9%, 1-click Promote to Playbook, Deliverable Pre-Flight Check, Save as routine, SHA-256 Client Pack .md, and 5,848 req/s).
